comment: Read from the repository at commit c3db83a, whose plugin.json carries the installed 2.0.2. Two of the four parameters, the gate threshold and the pad maximum, have no widget on the panel: they exist only as sliders on the context menu, so neither can be clicked and neither gets a line or a tag. The two inputs and the twelve analogue outputs carry no family, because what they mean is whatever you patch into X and Y: the module is used for audio and for control voltages equally, and the outputs are maxima, minima and means of the inputs rather than signals of a kind of their own. The twelve gate and trigger outputs are the exception and are tagged as triggers. Only the trigger outputs are computed lazily, and the gate outputs only when one of their pair is connected; the analogue outputs are always computed, because the panel lights read them. A pad's voltage falls off from the centre of the pad to nothing at its edge, and dragging across a pad while holding it moves that voltage — a gesture no click on a control will reveal.
